extracted.intended_audience: Organizations and individuals seeking NEH humanities grant funding (museums, historic sites, colleges/universities, K-12 teachers, libraries, public media stations, research institutions, independent scholars, nonprofits)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for prospective applicants on how to find appropriate NEH grant programs and what kinds of projects and applicants NEH funds. Focuses on matching project type and applicant to the correct NEH funding opportunity and observing program deadlines and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highest quality work to promote the humanities
rubrics_metrics.description: NEH offers a variety of grant programs to individuals and organizations that do the highest quality work to promote the humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should propose work that demonstrates high quality and a clear contribution to promoting the humanities; use NEH tools (quiz, grants search) to identify programs that prioritize such work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Match Your Project to a Grant Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Find the best funding opportunity for your project using our quiz or grants search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify funding opportunities appropriate for your proposed humanities project by matching the project's goals, scope, and format to the program descriptions and eligibility rules; use the online quiz or grants search to assist selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible applicant types
rubrics_metrics.description: NEH offers grant programs to museums, historic sites, colleges, universities, K-12 teachers, libraries, public television and radio stations, research institutions, independent scholars, and nonprofits nationwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm that your applicant type matches program eligibility before preparing an application; different programs serve individuals vs. organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books, Articles, and Other Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for books, articles, and other publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the specific NEH program pages for eligibility, allowable costs, and review criteria for publication projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curricula and Teaching Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for curricula and teaching resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review program requirements to ensure materials meet educational standards and intended audience needs; check for suitable program fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Projects (Websites, Software, and Other Tools)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for digital projects (websites, software, and other tools).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital projects should align with program goals for public access, preservation, and scholarly value; consult program guidance for technical and sustainability expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation & Access Projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for preservation and access projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preservation projects should demonstrate need, methodology for conservation/access, and plans for long-term availability according to program criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Humanities Projects (Historic Sites, Exhibitions, Media, and Other Programs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for public humanities projects such as historic sites, exhibitions, media, and other programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public-facing projects should show community engagement, interpretive plans, and alignment with program goals; consult program pages for audience and outreach expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowships, Conferences, Seminars, and Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for fellowships, conferences, seminars, and workshops.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These opportunities may have applicant-type, project scope, and timeline restrictions; verify eligibility and submission requirements for each specific program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Grant Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Funding Opportunities for other grant opportunities not captured in the main categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore NEH program listings and use the grants search to identify specialized or one-time funding initiatives relevant to your project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upcoming Application Deadlines (program-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists upcoming application deadlines for specific programs (examples shown: Collections Stewardship — May 11, 2026; Chairman’s Grants in Honor of America’s 250th Anniversary — May 31, 2026; Media Projects — June 25, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must observe program-specific deadlines; check the program page for full application requirements and exact due dates.
